glossary.definition:
(D) For purposes of this section, "claim" includes an unliquidated claim, but does not include a contingent liability that has not matured so that there is no immediate right to bring suit or a claim based on an event occurring after the effective date of dissolution.

(E) Nothing in this section shall be construed to extend any otherwise applicable statute of limitations.
glossary.source_title: Section 1706.7611 - Separate asset series-disposition of claims after dissolution.
